messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@nebulahealth.com>, Ava Collins <ava.collins@nebulahealth.com>, procurement@nebulahealth.com
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Portfolio uplift: Stage check + CS alignment for Nebula Health expansion

Hi Sara / Ava —

Quick check-in from my side as we get closer to the Q3 rollout window. We're tracking the Nebula expansion as an uplift (Seat + API usage) tied to the MSLA & scope doc we shared last week. Before I update finance's forecast, I need a short confirmation on two items from CS / procurement so we don't overstate the committed amount this quarter:

- Stage status: Is Nebula still at "Legal review" only, or has the CSM noted any technical blockers that would push implementation into late Q3?
- Go-live cadence: Best estimate of pilot -> full rollout timing (weeks). Our finance team wants a conservative commit date for revenue recognition purposes.

I attached the latest MSLA redline and the scope workbook with the line items we plan to include in the uplift. Can CS confirm the following by EOD Wed (6/16):
- Final stage label for the pipeline (Commit / Commit - conditional / Commit - legal only / Commit - at risk)
- Any training or integration milestones tied to invoicing (if we should stage revenue)

If it's helpful, Priyom and I can join a 20-min sync with your CSM to lock dates; otherwise a quick reply is fine.

Thanks — trying to keep this out of the Q3 forecast surprise queue.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.inference | (415) 555-0182

Attachments: Nebula_MSLA_v2.pdf (PDF, 214KB), Nebula_Q2_scope.xlsx (Excel, 48KB)

From: Sara Kim <sara.kim@nebulahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>, Ava Collins <ava.collins@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: procurement@nebulahealth.com
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portfolio uplift: Stage check + CS alignment for Nebula Health expansion

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear note. Quick answers:

- Stage status: Legal review in progress (we've sent MSLA back with two small redlines). No major technical blockers at this time; CSM flagged one API auth edge-case that the integrations team will handle during pilot.
- Go-live cadence: Pilot kickoff targeted for 7/12, two-week pilot, full rollout slated for 8/2 if pilot metrics look good. Procurement is reviewing pricing table and should respond to the redlines this week.

We should consider the uplift "Commit - legal only" for forecasting until the procurement sign-off lands. I can have procurement loop in with a definitive date once they finish internal review.

If Priyom or Jordan want to join the pilot kickoff and stay aligned on integration success metrics, that would be useful.

Sara Kim
Director, Clinical Integrations
Nebula Health
sara.kim@nebulahealth.com

On a side note, procurement@nebulahealth.com asked for a cleaned scope table with invoice milestones called out — can you supply that?

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.inference>
To: Sara Kim <sara.kim@nebulahealth.com>, Ava Collins <ava.collins@nebulahealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.inference>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portfolio uplift: Stage check + CS alignment for Nebula Health expansion

Appreciate the quick response, Sara — that's helpful.

Action items from our side:
- I'll produce a cleaned scope table that maps line items to invoice milestones (due EOD today).
- Priyom, can you coordinate with Finance on how we mark "Commit - legal only" in the commit view? We want to avoid double-counting in the rolling forecast.
- Monica / Marissa from CS: any objections to us classifying this as "Commit - legal only" for this week's forecast push? If procurement returns signed MSLA before Friday, we'll flip to "Commit" in the next refresh.

Quick note on risk: the auth edge-case Sara mentioned is low-effort but could shift pilot success metrics if not resolved in week 0. Monica, can your team put an owner on the integration task?

I'll attach the milestone-mapped scope as requested.

Thanks —
Jordan

Attachments: Nebula_Q2_scope_milestones.xlsx (Excel, 36KB)

Cc: Sara Kim <sara.kim@nebulahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 10:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portfolio uplift: Stage check + CS alignment for Nebula Health expansion — Forecast action

Thanks all — short finance note to close the loop.

1) Classification: Per Sara's confirm, we'll mark Nebula Health as "Commit - legal only" in this week's forecast. That means we will: 
   - Include the uplift in pipeline totals but exclude from hard-commit revenue for Q3 until the MSLA is countersigned.
   - Track a conditional commit line in the deal view to ensure it rolls into Commit automatically once procurement confirms.

2) Forecast numbers: Jordan, I've set the conservative commit amount to $145,000 for Q3 (pilot revenue excluded). If procurement signs before 6/18 we'll flip the amount to the full uplift $185,000 in the next refresh.

3) Next steps for CS: Monica / Marissa — please assign the integration owner and post a brief status (owner + ETA) in the HubSpot deal notes by EOD Thu (6/17). Link: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-9821

4) Procurement ask: Jordan / Sara, please send the milestone-mapped scope (invoice rows) to procurement@nebulahealth.com so they have the table for legal review.

I'll update the rolling forecast sheet after CS posts the owner and procurement confirms.

--
